It holds the rules that let an Orca coordinator run IronClaude `/sc:` commands as workers: the terms, the rules a command follows under `--unattended`, the duties of the worker session, and the coordinator's rules with its brief template. Each changed command adds a short `## Unattended mode` section that lists only its own gate resolutions and report file and points to this file, so the shared rules are written once.
